p1_b0.ocr: The table outlines various instruments and assessment areas utilized in a research context, detailing the time of assessments and the individuals applying these instruments. The first instrument, the Sampling form assistant, assesses age, sex, and inclusion/exclusion criteria at Baseline, applied by Research. The second instrument, the Sociodemographic data form assistant, examines age, sex, marital status, and educational level at Baseline, also applied by Research.

p1_b1.ocr: The table includes a reference to socio-economic group [29] and occupation, but this has no associated instrument or application. The SPPI psychiatric interview, administered by a psychiatrist [30], focuses on psychiatric diagnosis at Baseline, under Research. The Pain catastrophizing scale [20] assistant evaluates the severity of catastrophizing during Baseline and follow-up sessions*, with oversight by Research. The Hamilton test for Depression assistant [31,32] assesses severity of depression at Baseline and follow-up sessions*, managed by Research.
